```yaml
name: Vitest Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  vitest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Configure Vitest
      run: echo '{"coverage": {"provider": "c8"}}' > vitest.config.json

    - name: Run Vitest tests
      run: npm run test

    - name: Upload test coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v2
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-umbrella
        files: ./coverage/lcov.info
        verbose: true
```
